description: This PHP class 'PurgeCandidateListModel' resides in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin API models. It implements serialization of Candidate entities into a specific array format for API responses, including candidate details and status. The class is designed to be used within the OrangeHRM HRM system for managing candidate data in maintenance operations.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateListModel
classes.description: A model class that converts Candidate entity data into an array suitable for API responses, including candidate personal info and application status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Candidate entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Candidate entity into an associative array with specific key-value pairs for API serialization, including handling of candidate vacancy status.
